objective.value: Deliver ROOT-ISSUE-025 unified fail-closed restricted execution and ROOT-ISSUE-041 compact auditable MCP response presentation.

hard_constraints.value: Modify only the context-mode repository; do not push, publish, or modify parent, global, or sibling repositories.
Restricted execution must be project-contained, read-only, network-disabled, non-persistent, and fail closed when isolation is unavailable.
Implementation and checking stay inline in the current main session without Codex subagents or Trellis channel workers.
Codex host-owned Called input rendering is out of scope and must remain an explicit limitation.

decisions.value: Use one server-controlled execution policy for ctx_execute, ctx_execute_file, and ctx_batch_execute; caller input cannot create authority.
Restricted mode requires an explicit canonical CONTEXT_MODE_RESTRICTED_PROJECT_ROOT and a successful Linux bubblewrap probe; other platforms fail closed.
Use one typed bounded presentation policy; source and command zero values map to a tested 64-character minimum required by upstream #717/#736.
Restricted provenance and batch search remain request-local and never write FTS5, statistics, events, preload files, or readiness sentinels.

completed_work.value: Implemented the shared policy, bubblewrap launcher, request-local search, bounded presentation policy, startup and shutdown mutation guards, and explicit compatibility metadata.
Added policy, presentation, real subprocess, MCP lifecycle, persistence, response, and source-contract regressions.
Completed targeted tests, full 5011-test suite, typecheck, build, bundle assertions, deterministic hash check, real response measurements, and task validation.
Updated README, task evidence, RecoveryBrief MCP observations, quality check, and backend execution-boundary spec.

open_work.value: Create the reviewed implementation commit, finish the Trellis task, record final commit metadata/result, perform the final RecoveryBrief gate, and leave git status empty.

next_action.value: Stage the reviewed implementation and task assets, verify the staged diff, and create the component implementation commit without pushing.

project_state.value: Task harden-execution-project-boundary remains in_progress; implementation and all required quality checks pass, with only commit and finish bookkeeping open.
